column1: # The autosave at the start of Piccolo's canyon flight (a copy in the NSP folder, saves/canyon). Frame numbers: regress.py runs the game at its own 30 fps (the game profile's fps_target; no launcher settings), its first frame

# comes about 64 s after launch (the pipeline archive is prebuilt first), so frame f is at about 64 + f/30 s. Presses, from a run with these keys (shots every 15 s, 70 to 385 s): the title (Dragon Ball Z logo, then

# "Revisando contenido descargable" at 130 s) takes A at frames 1,500 and 1,900, the menu A at 2,300 (Continuar) and 2,700 (the autosave, "Cargar": "Confirmas que quieres cargar estos datos guardados?" with No

# highlighted at 160 s), Up at 3,100 selects Si and A at 3,500 loads it ("Guardando" at 190 s). A at 3,900 and 4,300 dismiss the first tutorial bubble (205 s). Piccolo then stands on the canyon edge facing the bridge, with the
# HUD, the minimap and the scrolling ticker from about 215 s (frame about 4,500); the shots stay on that picture. Checked on regress.py runs (see dm/games/010051C0134F8000/README.md)
